I

The Queen sat at a table by the window,
Watching her flowers grow;
And she kept one hand on the doorknob,
In case someone should come through.

Till the sun went down each day.

To the gentle summer breeze,

Tudor government has three functions: political, social and economic. When the wave of Love has washed us to shore,

There will be no other life than ours
To think or speak of; not a soul in reach
Of that great world between which I am borne,
But he who lies with me—God’s good enough!
